seed: Express the mechanics as pairwise interactions between types with named guards, such as blocking, pushing, collecting or toggling, and derive single-type rules from them.

synth.notes: A1-A4 step the player 3px; off-floor steps no-op; stepping into a pushable token kicks a chain (swept-path closure) that slides until floor edge, another token/player, or a socket interior it does not exactly fit (block w,h == inset-1 interior). Click (action_id 6) possesses the clicked token: player takes its x,y,w,h; tokens renamed token_i by (y,x). FLOOR = 4 inclusive px rects; player may stand in socket interiors, blocks may not unless exact-fit. Unconfirmed: A5/A7 unseen (no-op); socket filled-tag on docking; exact click semantics off-token.
